Title: In development: New planned datacenter region in India (India South Central)

Body.Content:
Microsoft will establish a new datacenter region in the country, offering Indian organizations local data residency and faster access to the cloud, delivering advanced data security and cloud solutions. The new datacenter region will also include availability zones, providing you with high availability and additional tolerance to datacenter failures. 

Learn more.
